text: SELECT "jaffle_shop"."dev"."products".product_id, "jaffle_shop"."dev"."products".product_name, SUM("jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items".product_price) AS revenue FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."products" ON "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items".product_id = "jaffle_shop"."dev"."products".product_id GROUP BY "jaffle_shop"."dev"."products".product_id, "jaffle_shop"."dev"."products".product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
